feed_items.text: Twice - K Grup TWICE es un grupo femenino de K-pop formado por JYP Entertainment en 2015 a través del programa de supervivencia Sixteen. Está integrado por Nayeon, Jeongyeon, Momo, Sana, Jihyo, Mina, Dahyun, Chaeyoung y Tzuyu. El grupo debutó oficialmente el 20 de octubre de 2015 con el miniálbum The Story Begins y rápidamente alcanzó gran popularidad gracias a canciones como “Like OOH-AHH”, “Cheer Up”, “TT”, “Likey” y “What Is Love?”. Con el paso de los años, TWICE se consolidó como uno de los grupos femeninos más reconocidos del K-pop, destacando por sus conceptos coloridos, coreografías pegadizas y una fuerte presencia internacional, especialmente en Corea del Sur, Japón y Estados Unidos.

feed_items.text: Breakfast for husband day 66 - Yuringi Rice Bowl Back from vacation and back with a new video! :) The key to this dish is keeping it a bit soupy—soak the rice in the sauce, top it with a piece of crispy chicken, and load it up with plenty of crunchy veggies. 1. Add 2 tbsp cooking oil and potato starch (any starch works) to a pan and mix. 2. Add 500g chicken thighs, mix well, and spread them skin-side down. 3. Season the chicken with salt and pepper. 4. Place a steamer basket with 250g mung bean sprouts on top of the chicken, cover with a lid, and cook for 10 minutes. 5. Mix 50ml soy sauce, 50ml vinegar, 50ml agave syrup, 50ml water, a splash of lemon juice, 1 tbsp minced garlic, and sliced chili peppers to make the sauce. tip : (Agave syrup can be replaced with honey or oligosaccharide syrup. If using sugar, use about 30g.) 6. Open the lid, remove the tender-crisp bean sprouts, and cook the chicken for 5 more minutes. 7. Flip and cook for 3 minutes, then flip again and sear over high heat for about 3 minutes until the skin turns crispy. 8. Place chicken, bean sprouts, and shredded green onions on top of rice, then pour the sauce over right before serving. 1. 식용유 2스푼 + 전분가루(어느 전분가루든 다 OK)를 후라이팬에 넣고 섞어줍니다 2. 닭다리살 500g 을 넣고 섞어준 후 껍질이 바닥으로 가도록 펼쳐줍니다 3. 닭다리살에 소금 후추 간을 해줍니다 4. 채반에 숙주 250g 을 넣고 닭위에 얹어 뚜껑을 닫고 10분간 익힙니다 5. 간장 50ml, 식초50ml, 아가베시럽50ml, 물 50ml, 레몬즙 약간, 다진마늘 1T, 고추를 섞어서 소스를 만들어줍니다 *아가베시럽은 꿀/올리고당으로 대체가능하고, 설탕으로 대체한다면 30g정도만 넣어주세요 6. 뚜껑을 열고 아삭하게 익은 숙주는 꺼내두고 닭은 5분 더 익힙니다 7. 뒤집어서 3분 익힌 후 다시한번 뒤집어서 껍질이 바삭해지도록 약 3분간 쎈불로 더 익혀줍니다 8. 밥 위에 닭, 숙주, 파채를 얹고 먹기 직전 소스를 끼얹어서 마무리합니다 #Yuringi #ChickenRiceBowl #KoreanFood #EasyRecipe #CrispyChicken

feed_items.text: Kawhi Leonard is one of the greatest two-way players in NBA history, known for his quiet personality, elite defense, and ability to take over in the biggest moments. Born on June 29, 1991, in Los Angeles, California, Leonard starred at San Diego State before being selected with the 15th pick in the 2011 NBA Draft. He was traded to the San Antonio Spurs on draft night, where he developed into a superstar under Gregg Popovich. Nicknamed “The Klaw” for his massive hands and defensive instincts, Leonard quickly became one of the league’s best perimeter defenders. Leonard helped the Spurs win the 2014 NBA Championship, earning Finals MVP after shutting down LeBron James during the series. After spending seven seasons in San Antonio, he was traded to the Toronto Raptors in 2018. In his only season with Toronto, Leonard led the Raptors to their first NBA title in franchise history, hitting one of the most iconic shots ever—a Game 7 buzzer-beater against the Philadelphia 76ers. He won his second Finals MVP, becoming one of only a few players to win the award with two different teams. In 2019, he signed with the Los Angeles Clippers, where injuries have often limited his availability despite his elite play when healthy. Kawhi Leonard is a 2-time NBA champion, 2-time Finals MVP, 2-time Defensive Player of the Year, and multiple-time NBA All-Star and All-NBA selection. Widely considered one of the greatest defenders ever, he combines incredible strength, huge hands, efficient scoring, and a calm demeanor that rarely changes under pressure. Although injuries have prevented him from adding even more accomplishments, Leonard’s playoff performances and ability to dominate both ends of the floor have cemented his legacy as one of the best players of his generation. #kawhileonard #basketball #nba #meme #viral

feed_items.text: Shohei Ohtani’s love for SpongeBob seems to go way beyond simply thinking the show is funny. He genuinely seems to appreciate the characters, the writing, and the deeper meaning hidden inside moments most people would normally laugh at and move on from. That’s exactly what he pointed out here while talking about Patrick Star — or “Subaru,” as Ohtani even calls him because of the viral online meme where people jokingly refer to Patrick as Subaru. Instead of focusing only on the joke about asking whether mayonnaise is an instrument, Ohtani looked at what the moment actually says about Patrick’s character. He respected the fact that Patrick didn’t know the answer and wasn’t afraid to admit it. Rather than pretending he understood something, he simply asked the question, even if it meant risking looking stupid in front of everyone else. Ohtani saw that as a sign of confidence and honesty rather than ignorance. It’s a funny example, but it also shows how Ohtani seems to look at characters differently. He pays attention to their personalities, their decisions, and the small moments that reveal who they really are. He doesn’t just watch SpongeBob for the jokes — he finds meaning in the character development and understands why certain scenes can say more than they appear to on the surface. Somehow, Ohtani can take one of the most ridiculous Patrick moments in SpongeBob history, acknowledge the Subaru meme at the same time, and still turn it into a genuine lesson about curiosity, confidence, and being comfortable enough with yourself to admit when you don’t know something

feed_items.text: Jaapani uue põlvkonna futuristic trap ja melodic drill skeenel on RYONEX tõusnud üheks kõige tähelepanuväärsemaks nimeks. Tema kiire flow, tumedad elektroonilised produktsioonid ja tugevalt cyberpunk’ist mõjutatud visuaalne stiil on aidanud tal lühikese ajaga koguda märkimisväärse kuulajaskonna. Eriti populaarne on ta noorte seas, kes jälgivad animekultuuri, videomänge ja internetipõhiseid kogukondi. Lood nagu „Tokyo Fade” ja „Chrome Heart” on toonud talle miljoneid kuulamisi ning koostöö erinevate Aasia produtsentidega on laiendanud tema mõju veelgi. Tema kontsertidel kasutatakse sageli glitch-efekte, futuristlikke visuaale ja julgeid biite, mis on muutunud oluliseks osaks artisti äratuntavast identiteedist. 2026. aastat peetakse RYONEXi karjääris oluliseks pöördepunktiks. Praegu koguvad suurt tähelepanu nii tema järgmise albumi filmilikud teaserid kui ka ettevalmistused suuremateks festivali-esinemisteks Tokyos j Soulis. feed_items.text: En las regiones altas de los Andes, algunas plantas crecen formando cojines densos y redondeados que parecen enormes almohadas verdes sobre las rocas. Esta forma compacta no es casual: les permite conservar calor y protegerse de los fuertes vientos que recorren las montañas. ╱╲╱ UN MICROCLIMA PROPIO ╲╱╲ Dentro de estos cojines, la temperatura puede ser notablemente más estable que en el aire exterior. Sus pequeñas hojas permanecen muy juntas, reduciendo la pérdida de agua y creando refugios donde también pueden vivir insectos y otros organismos diminutos. Una planta que apenas sobresale del suelo puede estar construyendo, centímetro a centímetro, su propio pequeño clima para sobrevivir.

Elokuussa 2026 huomio on keskittynyt erityisesti Hormuzinsalmeen, jonka kautta kulkee merkittava osa maailman meritse kuljetetusta öljysta. Alueen tankerillikenteen väheneminen, sotilaalliset välikohtaukset ja epäselvyys tulitauon tulevaisuudesta ovat lisanneet huolta siita, etta paikallinen kriisi voisi vaikuttaa paljon laajemmin energiakauppaan ja alueelliseen turvallisuuteen. Samaan aikaan diplomaattisia yhteyksia pyritaan edelleen pitämään avoimina. Tilanteen tekee vaikeaksi se, että Washington ja Teheran tulkitsevat aiempia sopimuksia eri tavoin samalla kun sotilaallinen paine jatkuu. Hormuzinsalmen merkitys tekee kriisistä kansainvälisen: pienikin häiriö alueella voi vaikuttaa kuljetuskustannuksiin, öljyn hintaan ja useiden maiden talouteen.

feed_items.text: Deja never took a step, but she’s always been Marquise’s way forward 💙 Marquise Goodwin’s whole career was fueled by something bigger than football, his relationship with his sister Deja. Goodwin was woken up one night in middle school by Deja, who is 10 months younger and unable to walk due to cerebral palsy, and heard her ask God to let her feel what it’s like to walk. That moment changed everything for him. He committed himself to maximizing his ability from that point on, saying he’d be doing her a disservice if he ever sat around being lazy or complaining instead of running, jumping, and competing. That’s not just motivation, that’s a bond that turned pain into purpose and built an entire NFL career. What’s the most powerful “why” you’ve ever heard from an athlete? feed_items.text: Why cargo ships go completely dark in pirate waters. When merchant vessels enter the Gulf of Aden, one of the world’s most piracy-prone shipping routes, they activate a strict protocol called “darken ship.” All non-essential lights are turned off. This allows crew on the bridge to adapt to low-light vision, making it easier to detect small fast-moving boats approaching in the dark. Meanwhile, the ship relies entirely on marine radar, GPS navigation, and gyrocompass systems to stay on course. Even a slight change in heading can increase the risk of interception. At night, a vessel carrying millions in cargo becomes a moving target in open ocean, where situational awareness and precision navigation are critical for survival. This is modern maritime security, naval engineering, and global trade logistics working together under extreme pressure. Could you navigate a cargo ship through pirate-infested waters in total darkness? Follow @thecoredesk for more real-world engineering and global systems. #maritime #shipping #engineering #globallogistics #technology #oceans #security #callofduty

feed_items.text: The Amazon holds an estimated 10% of all known species on Earth — inside a single connected ecosystem spanning nine countries. Brazil contains roughly 60% of it, but Peru, Colombia, Bolivia, Ecuador, Venezuela, Guyana, Suriname, and French Guiana all share a piece of it too. Scientists still discover new species there every year, and large sections remain so remote that researchers believe entire species groups haven’t even been catalogued yet. It’s one of the last places on Earth where the map still has genuine gaps in our knowledge. 🌳 Image credit: @dailyoverview @overview #amazonrainforest #geography #amazon

feed_items.text: I’m so incredibly happy to be able to share with you one of my favourite places in the entire World: the beautiful Azores 🏔️🌱🌀 This was the first time I’d ever visited Portugal and it absolutely blew my mind. I wasn’t expecting to fall so head over heels in love with this beautiful country. The Azores is just a whole nother planet. It’s filled to the brim with biodiversity, lush greenscapes, dramatic waterfalls, and the warmest locals. There are so many islands within the Azores, but we only visited three of the nine (Sao Miguel, Corvo and Flores). It turns out in hindsight going to the Azores for a week is a grave mistake… it’s simply impossible to see it all in that timeframe, but what a fantastic reason to visit again soon! 🤭 I am sooo excited to share more of my time in Portugal with you soon! @visitazores next time? 🤞🏼

feed_items.text: ONLY 30–40 PERCENT? 😭💀 James Harrison was built different. The man played football like every snap was personal, bringing a level of physicality and intensity that made even routine plays look violent. For an NFL linebacker, Harrison had an unbelievable combination of strength, explosiveness, speed, and instincts. His reputation wasn’t just about being strong. Harrison could rush the passer, chase plays from sideline to sideline, read the offense, and absolutely punish ball carriers. When he turned on the pressure, offensive linemen had one of the toughest jobs in football trying to keep him away from the quarterback. 🥶🏈 And then there’s the legendary mentality. Harrison wasn’t known for taking plays off or backing down from anybody. That relentless approach became part of his identity throughout his career, especially during his years with the Pittsburgh Steelers, where he became one of the most feared defensive players of his generation. If THIS is what 30–40% looks like, nobody wants to see 100%. 😭 The scary part about elite athletes isn’t just what they can do — it’s how effortless they can make something look when they’re operating at another level. **Was James Harrison one of the most terrifying defenders of his era? 👀** #JamesHarrison #NFL #PittsburghSteelers #NFLHighlights #FootballEdits

feed_items.text: The floating castle 🏰 Follow @nba.uganda If you’re still sleeping on Stephon Castle, it’s officially time to wake up. While the media loves to obsess over highlight-reel offense, Castle has quietly turned himself into one of the most terrifying defensive assignments in the entire league. Watching him guard the perimeter is pure art—he plays with a rugged, physical discipline that completely removes an opponent’s best scoring option from the game plan. He isn’t just a defensive specialist, either. When he’s attacking down hill, he plays with the explosive, fearless bounce of a young Ja Morant, putting defenders on posters and forcing teams to collapse the paint every time he drives. What makes Castle truly special is the ice in his veins. As a rookie playing under the absolute highest stakes of a Western Conference Finals run, he never looks rushed, never looks rattled, and completely embraces the dirty work required to win championships. Whether he’s picking up an All-Star guard 94 feet from the hoop, securing a crucial 50-50 ball in crunch time, or finishing a violent transition dunk to blow the roof off the arena, is the perfect, gritty engine fueling the new-era Silver and Black. The future of the backcourt is in perfectly safe hands. ❤️💞❤️ fypage

feed_items.text: John Wall was one of the most explosive and dynamic point guards of his era. Known for his blazing speed, athleticism, and playmaking ability, Wall could change a game in an instant. He was a constant threat in transition, using his quickness to attack the basket and create easy scoring opportunities for teammates. At his peak, he was one of the most exciting players in the NBA. As the face of the Washington Wizards, Wall helped lead the franchise to multiple playoff appearances and established himself as one of the league’s top point guards. His ability to score, distribute, and defend made him a complete floor general. Whether throwing pinpoint passes or finishing above the rim, Wall’s athleticism and competitiveness made him a fan favorite. What makes Wall’s story memorable is his resilience. After reaching All-Star status and becoming one of the NBA’s brightest stars, he faced a series of major injuries that limited his career. Despite those setbacks, Wall continued to work his way back and remained respected throughout the basketball world. His speed, leadership, and impact during his prime secured his place as one of the most talented guards of his generation. Credit: letsiletebogo #NBA #Wizards #Pelicans #Basketball

feed_items.text: 🇹🇼(Taiwan) Annie Yi [伊能靜] - Can’t Be Contained [關不住] (2001) Annie Yi (born Wu Jingyi; March 4, 1968) is a Taiwanese singer, actress, and writer active primarily in the Mandopop industry and Chinese-language entertainment. Born in Taipei to a Taiwanese mother and a father of Shandong origin, she debuted in the music scene at age 18 in 1987, releasing albums that established her as a teen idol through the 1990s. Yi expanded her career to Hong Kong and Japan in the early 1990s, adopting the stage name Annie Shizuka Inoh for her Japanese market activities, before returning to focus on acting in Taiwanese and mainland Chinese television dramas and films, as well as publishing personal essays and books reflecting on her life experiences. #MusicDiscovery #MusicReels #MusicTok #ElectronicMusic

feed_items.text: We’re really at that age where Lil Wayne and Kanye’s kids are making music together.. 😭 Song: MULA THA ROOT OF ALL EVIL Lil Novi and North West just linked up for a new song called MULA THA ROOT OF ALL EVIL. Lil Novi is Lil Wayne and Nivea’s 16-year-old son, and North West is Kanye West and Kim Kardashian’s 12-year-old daughter, so seeing their names together on a song is one of those full-circle hip-hop moments that makes you realize how fast time is really moving. This isn’t their first collab either. Earlier this year, North produced “Justswagup” for Mag!c and Lil Novi, which was reported as her first official production placement. She’s been getting attention for making rage-style beats and building out her own music direction, while Lil Novi has been making noise through the Young Money/Mötley Krëw world. Imagine trying to tell Lil Wayne and Kanye 20 years ago that their kids would be making music together in 2026 😭

feed_items.text: Russell Westbrook's iconic "Now I do what I want" commercial perfectly captured the moment he entered a new chapter of his career. After Kevin Durant left the Oklahoma City Thunder for the Golden State Warriors in 2016, Westbrook was suddenly the unquestioned leader of the team. The commercial played into the emotions surrounding KD's departure, showing Westbrook with a confident, almost defiant attitude. The phrase "Now I do what I want" felt like a statement that he was ready to take complete control and prove what he could accomplish on his own. That attitude carried directly onto the court. During the 2016-17 season, Westbrook averaged a triple-double, broke Oscar Robertson's single-season triple-double record at the time, and won his first NBA MVP award. Looking back, the commercial became more than just an advertisement-it represented the beginning of one of the most memorable individual seasons in modern NBA history. feed_items.text: Some relationships really do come full circle. Back in 2018, Barbara casually smiled and said, “Happy wife, happy life,” even though she and Dylan had only been dating for a few months. Nobody knew at the time how accurate that would become. Fast forward to 2024 and a photographer called her “Ms. Palvin.” Barbara immediately stopped, smiled and proudly corrected him. “It’s Mrs. Sprouse.” Before anyone else could react, Dylan shouted from behind the cameras, “You tell ‘em, baby!” The clip instantly went viral because it wasn’t awkward at all. It was just two people genuinely happy to be married. Then came Cannes in 2026. This time, photographers welcomed them as “Mr. and Mrs. Sprouse.” No corrections needed. Barbara and Dylan looked at each other, smiled, and let out the most satisfying little “Aha.” The moment became even sweeter after the couple confirmed they were expecting their first child together. From “Happy wife, happy life” to “Mrs. Sprouse” to starting a family, the internet watched the whole story unfold one red carpet at a time. feed_items.text: LeBron James' decision to leave the Miami Heat in 2014 has long been associated with basketball reasons—an aging roster, salary cap concerns, and his desire to return home to Cleveland. But a recently resurfaced story from former teammates has given fans another glimpse into the dynamics behind the end of the Heat's Big Three era. Michael Beasley and Dwyane Wade recently revisited the now-infamous "cookie incident," recalling how Pat Riley reportedly removed LeBron's favorite chocolate chip cookies from team flights as part of the Heat's strict culture and conditioning standards. According to Beasley, the seemingly minor decision became a memorable moment inside the organization and highlighted some of the growing tensions during Miami's final season with LeBron. Of course, one missing dessert didn't determine LeBron's future. By 2014, the Heat had already reached four consecutive NBA Finals and captured back-to-back championships, but questions about the roster's future and James' long-term goals continued to grow. The "cookie-gate" story has since become one of the NBA's most entertaining behind-the-scenes anecdotes—not because it changed history, but because it offered a glimpse into the intense culture that defined one of basketball's greatest dynasties. Sometimes, the smallest moments tell the biggest stories. feed_items.text: This video captures from the outset a poignant contrast between former college football player Greg Brooks Jr.’s current life and his past athletic career. It begins with emotional interview clips, starting with an older press conference where Brooks discusses dealing with vertigo. The footage then shifts to an ABC News Exclusive interview where it is revealed that Brooks has not heard from the LSU coaching staff, specifically head coach Brian Kelly, since October 2023. A family member next to him emphasizes the hurt this caused, urging Kelly to simply call and show care. In a subsequent podcast appearance, Brooks is asked if he misses the game, admitting it is difficult to watch on screen knowing that should be him. The segment concludes on a somber note as Brooks is wheeled away and the host breaks down in tears. The second half of the video transitions into a dynamic compilation of Brooks' highlights on the football field, celebrating his athletic legacy. The footage showcases his time playing as number 9 for the Arkansas Razorbacks and number 3 for the LSU Tigers. It features a sequence of his most impressive plays, including intense tackles, interceptions, and key defensive moments. The vibrant game-day clips provide a sharp contrast to the previous emotional interviews, serving as a powerful reminder of his impact on the field before his health struggles. feed_items.text: Interesting Fact: The "Cuckoo’s Egg" of Data Drift - In MLOps, a model can be mathematically perfect but fail because of Data Drift. This happens when the "real world" changes but the model’s environment doesn't. In 2020, many high-frequency trading and inventory models broke because they couldn't process the sudden shift in human behavior during lockdowns. MLOps teams now use Kullback-Leibler (KL) Divergence, a formula to measure how much the current data "distribution" has moved away from the training data to trigger an automatic "emergency" retraining. #ai #llm #mlops #machinelearning #memes

feed_items.text: DJ's doing the absolute most, but Rich Homie Quan still hit that note clean. The crowd is roaring and that classic energy hits different. But the biggest conversation in rap right now is in the Arab world, where Palestinian artist Shabjdeed just dropped a track called "SLV" that has everyone talking. The New Arab reported five hours ago that fans expected another diss track aimed at Saint Levant, and the release became far more than a simple rap beef. That personal rivalry turned into a sprawling controversy dominating the entire Arab music scene. Shabjdeed and Saint Levant have been trading shots for a while, and fans were expecting pure fire. But "SLV" refuses to play the classic diss track game. Instead of tearing down his rival, Shabjdeed shifts the focus to bigger questions about representing Palestine in global hip hop, authenticity, and who gets to tell that story. That decision is why the discourse exploded. Fans are breaking down bars, commentators are writing think pieces, and the song has become a referendum on the direction of Arab rap. It is no longer about two artists, it is about the entire culture and its political weight. And that weight is exactly what fans are latching onto. The timing matters because Arab rap is having a global moment. Artists from the region are breaking out internationally, and this feud is the lens new listeners are using to discover the genre. Shabjdeed has always been uncompromising and politically charged, but "SLV" amplifies that reputation. Meanwhile Saint Levant's camp is not staying silent, and the back and forth fuels the fire. Five hours after The New Arab's report, the conversation is still raging. One song has shifted the whole landscape, and it is only getting louder. For anyone who loves rap, this is essential listening.

feed_items.text: Six months ago Leopold Aschenbrenner was the most celebrated trade on Wall Street. Today his fund is liquidating. Situational Awareness LP, the $20 billion hedge fund he built from $225 million in under two years using a concentrated AI infrastructure thesis, has sold its entire leveraged book of public equities after the July selloff hammered long positions in CoreWeave, Bloom Energy, Nebius, Lumentum, and Coherent, while short bets against software names including Adobe also moved against the fund. The firm is now working with prime brokers at Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan to meet margin calls, seeking fresh capital from existing investors, and has offered some of them the chance to buy portfolio assets directly. The fund was up 439% net through June 30, running leverage as high as 4x on the same bets that are now forcing emergency conversations. The arc is one of the fastest reversals in recent hedge fund history. Aschenbrenner left OpenAI in 2024, published a 165-page AGI essay that went viral, raised a $225 million fund, and compounded it to $20 billion in roughly 18 months on a single thesis: AGI is coming fast and whoever owns the infrastructure wins. He told investors as recently as July 24 that the selloff was “one of the best buying opportunities since early 2025” and invited new capital starting August 1. Six days later the fund was liquidating its public book. He still holds private stakes including a position in Anthropic, and the thesis has not changed. Whether investors want maximum leverage to that thesis through the first serious drawdown is a different question entirely. feed_items.text: Playing at Oracle Arena wasn’t just another road game, it felt like walking into chaos for 48 minutes. The crowd was loud before tip-off even started, and once the Warriors got rolling, the whole building turned into a nightmare for opposing teams. 💀 Steph hitting impossible shots, Klay catching fire in seconds, and Draymond feeding off the energy made that arena feel unfair sometimes. You could see teams fold in real time because the noise, momentum, and pressure at Oracle were different from anywhere else in the NBA. There’s a reason so many players still talk about Oracle like it was basketball hell for road teams. feed_items.text: On Wednesday night in Soho, a line wrapped around the block at McNally Jackson, the independent New York City bookstore. Lines for sneaker drops and designer bags are usually more common than lines for paperbacks in the trendy neighborhood, but tonight was a special occasion: As a promotion for his new album, rapper Jack Harlow had offered to buy one book per customer from 6:30 to 8:30 p.m. When we heard this news, the Pitchfork staff had some questions. Was this real? Who was the target audience? Was anyone going to buy The Power Broker? Naturally, we had to go find out. Swipe through to meet some of the voracious readers charging John Steinbeck and Octavia Butler to Harlow's card.

feed_items.text: Ungatekeeping Deviation the Korean footwear brand you should know about. Some of you will remember my post earlier this year on Reproduction of Found a brand producing some great iterations of the German Army Trainer. Another brand you should be aware of is @deviation__official hailing from South Korea. Which are producing some great reproductions of some of our favourite silhouettes. I’m talking the German Army Trainer and Wallabee. I can’t speak from personal experience but in the process of building out this post I’ve researched Deviation and the quality is well above the accessible price point. Deviation offer a range of colourways and mixed materials across the range speak for themselves. Next time you are in the market for some new webs maybe check out Deviation.
